name: Care Compass
tagline: Ranks nearby hospitals and clinics by the fastest path to care, not just distance.

awards: Best Athena AI Agent for University Students

problem: In emergencies the closest hospital is not always the fastest because of traffic and wait times.
solution: Combines live traffic ETAs, severity and provider-reported wait times to rank facilities.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter symptoms and get the facility you would be seen at soonest.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Athena AI Agent for University Students” among 127 submissions.

lessons: Redefine 'nearest' as 'soonest' and the value is obvious.
